# Quotix

> Quotix is a done-for-you growth service for clinics in Indore, India. It edits reels from the clinic's own footage, runs a WhatsApp assistant that sends reminders and follow-ups to the clinic's existing patients, and keeps the clinic set up to be found on Google and in AI search.

- Who it is for: dermatology, dental, IVF, hair transplant and cosmetic clinics. Weight-loss clinics are not taken.
- Plans (3-month minimum): Essential Rs 30,000/month, Growth Rs 45,000/month, Flagship Rs 75,000/month (ad spend extra).
- One-time setup: Rs 17,000 for a 5-page website, 5 blog posts, Google Business Profile and AI search setup; credited against month one if a plan starts within 30 days.
- Fees are fixed and never tied to patient numbers or referrals.
- Content is educational only: no testimonials, no guaranteed results.
- Case study: ALTRcare, a doctor-led telehealth practice built by the same team.
- Contact: hello@quotixai.com
